name: T Marzetti Co
old_description: Roll up the delectable Marzetti Classic Caramel Dip into this deliciously sweet twist on an old classic Babka.
about:
T Marzetti Co operates from Columbus, Ohio, where it was founded in 1896. The company’s ownership structure and founding family are not disclosed in public sources.

The manufacturer produces a range of refrigerated and shelf-stable foods, including salad dressings, slaw dressings, veggie dips, caramel dips, fruit dips, chocolate dip, and croutons. Product lines such as Protein Ranch, Simply Dressed, and Non-Refrigerated Dressings are marketed under the Marzetti brand. Facility size, employee count, and annual production volumes are not published.

The company’s products are sold through retail channels and featured in consumer recipes on its website. No specific industrial or foodservice customers are identified in available materials.

Marzetti emphasizes “real ingredients” in its messaging, though no formal differentiation claims or origin story are provided in the source text.
